runner.label: Momentum Runner
runner.tagline: Paper shadow of Trend & Breakout's index trades: same entry, the stop left alone until +3 R, then trailed 3 R behind the best price.
runner.markets: every index market the main bot trades

bandbreaker.label: Band Breaker
bandbreaker.tagline: Intraday index momentum: a band of normal noise around the open; a half-hour close outside it is the trade; stop at the far band or VWAP; flat before the close.
bandbreaker.rule: average noise of the last 14 sessions; checks every 30 min from 10:00; at most 3 entries a day per market; 10 at the stop

crowd.label: Crowd Fader
crowd.tagline: Positioning from Coinversa: when the losing crowd is stretched one way and the proven winners are not with them, lean the other way once the price turns; stop beyond the last hour, target the nearest liquidation cluster.
crowd.rule: crowd 50% net one way and the winners not with them; score 60+; entry on a 15-min close beyond the last 8; stop beyond the last 4 bars; target the nearest cluster or 2 R; out after 24 h; at most 2 a day per market; 10 at the stop (the smallest size up to 30); reads every 10 min
